text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian conquers the Tenno Sho 
(Spring). Amid the ceaseless cheers for 
her victory over the dark horse, Rice 
Shower rises again, unbroken.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having witnessed the strength of her 
spirit firsthand, Narita Brian vowed to 
become even stronger herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To reach the very top, Narita Brian takes 
on the Tenno Sho (Autumn)— the first leg 
of the Autumn Senior Triple Crown.
